name: ImageTrail-TS-TW
title: Image Cursor Trail
description: A large heading sits on a dark card while snapshots of coastlines pop up along the pointer path, each one growing, drifting and shrinking away.
use: A photography or design portfolio wants a memorable reveal on mouse movement.
avoid: It needs pointer travel to show anything, and the images cycle through a fixed list with no captions.
a11y: Photos are background images with no alt text, and the trail only appears on pointer move, so keyboard and screen-reader users get nothing. (keyboard: n-a, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide dark panel with a huge tight white heading centred and a small caption beneath. Small rounded photo cards of piers, waves and hills appear near the pointer, stacked with soft shadows.
behaves: Every eighty pixels of pointer travel spawns the next photo at the pointer, which slides into place, then fades and shrinks to nothing. Photos cycle through the list and pile over the heading.
customise: The photo list arrives as an array of URLs, and variant selects one of eight trail animations. Card size, distance threshold and timing are fixed in the source.
weight: moderate: An endless requestAnimationFrame loop drives a handful of GSAP-tweened photo cards.
demo: Heading "Image Trail" with the caption "Move your cursor across the canvas".
issues: The trail vanishes when the pointer is still, so frame 1 is a bare heading.
Background-image photos carry no alt text or captions.
polishWhy: Crisp photo cards and a lively stack; the heading behind them is crowded and easily covered.
